title: African Scholars Programme
field: Public policy, international affairs, data science for public policy
about: The Hertie School's African Scholars Programme is a scholarship programme for nationals of listed African countries applying to its Master of Public Policy, Master of International Affairs or Master of Data Science and AI for Public Policy. The master's application is due by 1 December.
requirements: Nationals of listed African countries facing economic challenges
Master's application must be submitted by the 1 December Early Bird deadline
Funding application opens only after admission, with two weeks to complete it; short leadership essay required
Only one full scholarship application per year

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI II
